question: __________ partners with DAY-NULM towards empowering women entrepreneurs in June 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNDP**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **UNDP** partnered with DAY-NULM in June 2023 to empower women entrepreneurs.
 
• DAY-NULM stands for **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission**, which aims at reducing poverty and vulnerability of the urban poor households.
 
• The collaboration focuses on providing skill development, training, and financial assistance to women entrepreneurs to enhance their livelihoods.
 
• This partnership is part of a broader effort to promote gender equality and economic empowerment of women in urban areas.
 
• UNDP (United Nations Development Programme) plays a crucial role in supporting sustainable development goals and improving human development indicators globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNDP** works in nearly 170 countries and territories, helping to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities, and build resilience so countries can sustain progress.
 
• **DAY-NULM** was launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation, Government of India, to uplift the urban poor by enhancing sustainable livelihood opportunities through skill development and access to credit.
 
• This partnership aims to integrate women into the economic mainstream by providing them with the necessary resources and support to start and grow their businesses.
 
• Such initiatives are vital for achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly those related to poverty reduction, gender equality, and economic growth.
